Description: Name that the Aiel used for Lan. It means "One Man Alone"
The fiery Seanchan Captain of the Air.
A Domani sword-swallower and fire-eater with Luca’s show.
A Whitecloak. He was supposedly the head of Pedron Niall's network of spies.
Mat's father. A farmer  and horse trader from Emond's Field.
A lord in Andor and the High Seat of House Pendar.
An Asha’man who did not need to be Turned to follow Taim.
An Andoran man who allegedly got drunk and spent the night on the inn roof.
One of Renald Fanwar’s farmhands.
A Jenn Aiel around the time of the Breaking.
A Two Rivers boy whom Mat Cauthon tried to trick.
The leader of the band of Darkfriends who kidnapped Egwene, Nynaeve and Elayne.
A lanky young woman with a pimply face who worked as a stablehand for Toke Fearnim in Jurador.
An Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and the rebel contingent. Sister to Vandene.
A Maiden of the Jindo sept of the Taardad Aiel who has yellow hair.
A Saldaean Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the loyalist contingent.
Almen Bunt’s thirteen-year-old nephew. He had golden hair.
An Andoran Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and the rebel contingent.
A Two Rivers woman who was Flann’s wife.
A soldier of the Band of the Red Hand under Captain Mandevwin.
A stout farmer with lank hair in Kore Springs, Andor.
A Tairen merchant whom Rand eavesdropped on in Far Madding.
The young sister of Perrin Aybara.
Perrin’s granddaughter in a scenario created in the battle between Rand and the Dark One.
A slim contortionist in Valan Luca’s show.
An Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the loyalist contingent.
A Saldaean soldier. While guarding Lord Tellaen’s manor, he was struck by a bubble of evil.
Almen Bunt’s dead wife.
A Warder to one of the ferrets sent to the White Tower.
Andoran Lord Lir Baryn’s sister.
The High Seat of House Matherin in Andor and a supporter of Elayne.
An Ancient king of Safer who defeated a Manetheren army at Midean’s Ford.
A crewman for Bayle Domon on the Spray.
An Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and the rebel contingent.
A woman of Tanchico, never seen, who was called to by a dreaming man.
A Domani Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. Lean, with coppery skin and short white hair.
The mother of Beonin Marinye. She was a merchant in Tanchico.
Romanda Cassin’s longtime serving woman.
A nobleman who was the leader of the Amadician contingent at the Battle of the Shining Walls.
A farrier in Perrin’s camp in Ghealdan.
The plump High Seat of House Carand, a major House in Andor.
The last King of Manetheren. His wife was Eldrene.
A man of the Two Rivers who appeared in Nynaeve’s test for the shawl.
A respected Wise One of the Black Water sept of the Nakai Aiel who could not channel.
The local lady of Jurador, a salt town in Altara. She swore the Oaths of Return to the Seanchan.
An Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the rebel contingent.
A loyal Guardsman of the Royal Guards in Caemlyn. He escorted Samwil Hark to meet with Elayne.
The innkeeper of The Dragon in Tear. He was lean, balding, fair-complected and dark-eyed.
The Lord of Fal Dara in Shienar, considered to be one of the five great captains of the time.
A lancer with Bashere’s army who accompanied Rand to meet the purported Daughter of the Nine Moons.
A Forsaken whose original name was Ishar Morrad Chuain. Reincarnated as Osan'gar.
A Maiden of the Spear of the Shelan sept of the Daryne Aiel who died at Dumai’s Wells.
The misogynistic, smuggling captain of the Riverserpent.
A woman of the Two Rivers; she was the mother of Kenley.
A Sea Folk Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and the loyalist contingent. She worked in the Thirteenth Depository.
A serving woman in the Aesdaishar Palace in Chachin.
The stern innkeeper of The Evening Star in Chachin.
A Wise Woman in Tear. Also known as "Mother Guenna".
A Cairhienin noblewoman. She was 5'6" tall, and slim and dignified, with big dark eyes.
The King of Amadicia. He was not as handsome as rumor put him.
An Emond’s Field woman with a neat house.
An Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah with a strength level of 14(2).
A Tuatha’an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the loyalist contingent, with a strength level of 16(4).
A Kaensada Hills tribesman who served Furyk Karede as manservant and scout for nearly twenty years.
An Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 34(22).
The name of the Domani razor mare that Mat gave to Tuon; it is an Old Tongue word meaning “swallow.”
The last crowned King of Malkier, and father to Lan Mandragoran.
An Amadician Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the loyalist contingent, with a strength level of 24(12).
He was Bili al’Dai’s grandfather. He is lean, has wispy white hair and is about as old as Master Cole.
An Emond’s Field woman who was concerned that the storks had not returned to Emond’s Field.
A farmer in the Two Rivers; his scythe blade was broken by Perrin early in his blacksmith training.
A Two Rivers woman who was Dael’s mother.
An Ogier who was the daughter of Soferra and the mother of Damelle.
A Murandian Lord Captain of the Children of the Light. He was short and bald.
A Cairhienin noblewoman, wife of Doressin, who cornered Rand at Barthanes’ party.
A plump Amadician silversmith who was taken gai’shain by the Shaido.
A chief of the Tomanelle Aiel after the Last Battle, seen in Aviendha’s vision of the future in Rhuidean.
A member of the Domani Council of Merchants. She went into hiding, but Rhuarc found and held her.
An Arafellin Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 17(5).
The Eldest of the Elders of Stedding Tsofu. She was the mother of Iva and the grandmother of Erith.
Son of Aviendha and Rand, seen in Aviendha’s view of the future in Rhuidean.
A Wise One of the Shaido Aiel (but not Jumai) with the ability to channel.
The officer in charge of recruitment for Bryne’s army.
Furyk Karede’s horse, a bay. The name was Old Tongue for “eagle.”
Laman’s brother and Moiraine’s uncle. He was cruel and vicious.
Moiraine’s mare that she rode when she went to the Two Rivers. The name means “West Wind.”
An Amadician bookkeeper who was taken gai’shain by the Shaido. Aldin was tall and square-shouldered.
A mercenary commander working for Arymilla. He attacked Caemlyn and was killed by Birgitte.
A Cairhienin mercenary captain who took service with Elayne.
A captain in the Cairhienin army in charge of excavating the male Choedan Kal statue.
A Taraboner Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 24(12).
The stately First Counsel of Far Madding. She was 5'7" tall, with long black hair heavily winged with white.
An Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who served as Amyrlin from 890 to 922 NE.
Egwene’s second-eldest sister. She was born in 969 NE and allowed to braid her hair at sixteen.
An author of humorous tales.
The leader of the Ghealdanin contingent at the Battle of the Shining Walls, and a Lord.
The daughter of Ishara, and her successor to the throne of Andor. She reigned from FY 1020 to 1035.
A woman who served as shatayan to King Easar of Shienar. She was the head housekeeper.
The innkeeper at The Bellon Ford Inn in Amadicia, where Elayne and Nynaeve stayed.
A Tairen Lesser Lord of the Land. He also went by "Emarin".
The last man to sit on the Crystal Throne of Seanchan; he ruled over a thousand years.
A nobleman of a minor Cairhienin House and an officer in the Band of the Red Hand.
A scout in the Children of the Light. Alhanra found Gawyn, badly injured, in the Last Battle.
An Aes Sedai of the White Ajah who served as Amyrlin from 332 to 355 NE.
The wife of Weilin Aldragoran; he thought that she would have loved to meet Nynaeve.
A young Jenn Aiel man who accompanied Lewin to rescue their sisters from bandits.
A cavalry leader in Ituralde’s army at Maradon.
A Kandori officer who commanded Lord Varan’s guards at Canluum.
A legendary Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.
A plump maid in the Tarasin Palace in Ebou Dar who Olver thought was sweet.
A Taraboner Kinswoman. Her strength level was 46(34).
A damane from Seanchan who was captured by Rand’s army and then traveled with him.
A Warder who lost his Aes Sedai in the Last Battle and joined Galad to fight on and avenge her.
The Queen of Ghealdan, Blessed of the Light, Defender of Garen’s Wall and a dozen more titles.
A dark-haired Andorman, with a half-beard shaved at the sides, who served under Uno in the Last Battle.
High Lady Suroth’s lopar.
An old Andoran farmer. He had a well-wrinkled, leathery face, and half his teeth were missing. Also called "Bunt".
The First Counselor of Tova, a nation that arose after the Trolloc Wars, located at the same site as Cairhien.
A Seanchan Seeker for Truth, about 5'10" tall, with yellow hair and blue eyes.
A Jenn Aiel woman who lived during the Breaking. Her husband was Jonai.
The oldest member of the Kin. She was nearly six hundred years old.
An Andoran farmer living between Four Kings and Market Sheran. He gave Rand and Mat a ride.
Siuan’s Warder. He was killed the day she was deposed.
An ancient scholar who wrote of Mesaana’s schools in the War of Power.
The King of Arad Doman, Lord of Almadar, High Seat of House Almadar.
The wife of Haral Luhhan, the blacksmith of Emond’s Field. She was born in 955 NE.
A Wise One of the Salt Flat sept of the Nakai Aiel. She served as Bruan’s Wise One at Shiagi Hold.
A Taraboner lacquerware merchant who played Piri in The White Ring in Maderin.
A noblewoman of Amadicia who served as a lady-in-waiting to Morgase under the command of Pedron Niall.
A High Lady of Tear who was the wife of Tedosian. She was tall and slender with large brown eyes.
A Two Rivers novice with the rebel Aes Sedai. She tried to convert two cups to cuendillar.
An Illuminator and onetime Mistress of the chapter house in Cairhien. She was born in 959 NE.
An Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah who served as Amyrlin from 549 to 578 NE.
An Amadician Aes Sedai of the White Ajah publicly and the Black Ajah in truth.
A Cairhienin novice in the White Tower. She was short and slim with big eyes and long dark hair.
An Amadician woodcutter, a stocky man with a weathered face and a coarse, almost unintelligible accent.
A Seanchan sul’dam with blue eyes, sharp features, and a tight, thin-lipped mouth.
A male servant in Lady Arilyn’s house in Cairhien who liked to tickle maids’ chins.
The cobbler in Emond’s Field.
Moiraine’s favorite alias. Sometimes "Lady Alys" and sometimes "Mistress Alys" (which is more common).
Almen Bunt’s sister. She and her husband Graeger had two sons, Hahn and Adim.
The name that Galina Casban used after being captured and taken to Perrin.
Leane’s alias after she was stilled.
The first wife of Artur Hawkwing. He loved her very much, and wrote many poems to her.
A Lady of House Jagad in Shienar. Agelmar’s sister, Amalisa was short and in her middle years.
The mother of Elora and the daughter of Coura, an Ogier.
A female Hero of the Horn who carried the Sword of the Sun.
An Aiel woman, the greatdaughter of Sorilea and the greatmother of Taric.
A Taraboner woman. She was in born in 974 NE. She was about 5'5" tall and very pretty and slender.
The husband and Swordmaster of Zaida din Parede Blackwing.
A Darkfriend woman in Amador, stern-faced and graying. She and her husband Jorin were rich merchants.
A member of the Seanchan Blood who attended Tuon’s first audience in Ebou Dar.
An Arafellin Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah publicly, and of the Black Ajah in truth.
A daughter of Artur Hawkwing and Amaline Paendrag Tagora.
A Taraboner Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and the loyalist contingent, with a strength level of 27(15).
A Cairhienin nobleman who supported Colavaere for the throne.
An Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah whom Zaida brought back with her from Caemlyn.
A Wise One of the Nine Valleys sept of the Taardad Aiel. She was first-wife of Rhuarc.
An Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 15(3).
A High Lady of Tear and a Darkfriend. She was willowy and darkly beautiful, but she frequently simpered.
An Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was slim with long black hair.
A former queen of Altara. Her family ruled for five generations, the longest on record.
A favorite poet of Moiraine.
Tuon’s Truthspeaker, or Soe’feia; she was actually Semirhage in disguise.
A Taraboner Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the loyalist contingent, with a strength level of 24(12).
An acrobat with Valan Luca’s show. She was one of six sisters.
A bootmaker in the town of Taien in the Jangai Pass.
A skinny, toothless turnip farmer from the south of Cairhien who gave Rand and his companions a ride.
A Malkieri who worked for a time as a Kandori soldier.
A Maiden of the Red Salt Goshien. Her name appeared on Rand’s list of women who died for him.
A woman who worked in the kitchen of the Sun Palace in Cairhien.
A name sometimes used by Lan while on the road.
The King of Tarabon at the time of the Seanchan invasion. He and Amathera were lovers.
A man featured in a slightly bawdy song sung at The White Ring in Maderin.
Sammael’s emissary to Rand who offered a truce and then died, sweating blood.
Meilyn Arganya’s Warder. Lean and no taller than Meilyn, he appeared youthful.
A Taraboner Asha’man. Approximately thirty years old when he went to the Black Tower.
A banker in Caemlyn who made a loan to Elayne upon the discovery of alum on her estates.
A plump Accepted of the loyalist contingent. She told Elaida of a woman seeking an audience.
One of Halwin Norry’s most trusted clerks, a graying woman who worked for Birgitte in Caemlyn.
A Seanchan soldier sent by Karede to Ebou Dar.
An Amyrlin from the past. Isebele of Dal Calain had enough power to force Anghara to come to her.
An Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah who was Sierin Vayu’s Keeper of the Chronicles.
A novice with the Salidar Aes Sedai. Born in 973 NE, she went to the White Tower at age seventeen.
Leane’s Warder, whom she bonded in 977 NE. He died in 984 NE.
A powerful Domani nobleman whom Ituralde courted to help with his plans against the Seanchan.
Someone of whom thousands of tales were told.
An Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and a Sitter for the Blue at the time of the Aiel War.
A messenger for Bryne in the Last Battle. She died when a raken was shot down and landed on her.
A Saldaean Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 17(5).
A Taraboner Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah, uncommitted to any faction. Her strength level was 33(21).
A Warder and hero during the Trolloc Wars; his Aes Sedai was Barashelle.
An Asha’man who was quiet and thin-haired, and skilled in Healing.
A stout Andoran noblewoman and High Seat of her minor House. She was loyal to Elayne.
The eldest son of Queen Ethenielle and Prince Brys and thus the heir to the throne of Kandor.
Moiraine’s older sister, who cared for nothing but hawking and horses and had a terrible temper.
A serving woman in Aesdaishar Palace who served Lan when he visited.
A serving man at The Stag and Lion in Baerlon. He was a slight, dark-haired fellow.
A High Lord of Tear who was slender and graying, with a long-smoldering temper and suspicious nature.
The grandson of Raen and Ila, born in 978 NE. He was slender and very handsome.

Alphabetical Name: Aran son of Malan son of Senar
Full Name: Aran son of Malan son of Senar
Description: A respected Ogier author, born circa 50 AB, who wrote a manuscript about Ishamael.
Balthamel's name after he was resurrected and put into a woman’s body; she took the name Halima Saranov.
The Captain-General of the Queen’s Guard of Andor at the time of the Aiel War.
The High Seat of House Renshar, a very powerful Andoran House. She was beautiful when young.
An Amadician woman who was a gai’shain in Sevanna’s camp.
An Aes Sedai of the loyalist contingent who helped to capture Leane at Southharbor.
Rahvin’s name before he turned to the Shadow.
A Kandori woman. Born in 978 NE, she was 5'4" tall, with blue eyes and dark hair.
A Cairhienin blacksmith who became an Asha’man and bonded Aisling Noon of the Green Ajah.
The uncle and guardian of Catalyn Haevin of Andor.
An Ogier, the son of Halan and the father of Loial.
An Illianer nobleman who was a member of the Council of Nine.
An Ogier of the distant past; his son Jalanda wrote of Be’lal.
A woman who lived in Taien, Jangai Pass and survived the Shaido attack.
An Andoran noblewoman and High Seat of House Branstrom.
A Cairhienin noblewoman who was part of the Gray Ajah’s eyes-and-ears network.
Selande’s brother, who was part of the Illian invasion army. He was a stocky young man.
A gate guard in Baerlon.
Sheriam’s Cairhienin Warder. Slender and about 5'7" tall with gray at his temples.
A Saldaean Asha’man soldier, copper-skinned, with a thin mustache and a small pearl in his ear.
Arymilla’s maid. Her duties went beyond the usual. She is sllender and pretty.
One of the two toughs with Falion and Ispan when they tortured the Kinswoman Callie in Ebou Dar.
A Seanchan soldier at Malden, under the command of Mishima.
A Tairen woman who was a member of Cha Faile. She wore her black hair cut as short as a Maiden’s.
Birgitte’s lean gray horse.
Moiraine’s bay mare, later replaced by Aldieb.
A legendary king who united all lands west of the Spine of the World. Also a Hero of the Horn.
The birth name of Artur Hawkwing.
A Youngling under Gawyn’s command.
High Seat of House Marne in Andor. She was a sycophant of Gaebril, and later declared for the Lion Throne.
A Cairhienin officer who met Rand, Hurin and Loial at their entrance to the city of Cairhien.
An Altaran novice in the White Tower. She was a plump, pretty girl with olive-colored skin.
A merchant in Canluum who was also a wilder.
A superior servant of Barthanes in Cairhien.
An Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 22(10).
A Whitecloak spy in Tanchico, sent there by Pedron Niall to sound out possibilities amid the chaos.
A Forsaken. His name in the Age of Legends was Joar Addam Nessosin. His strength level was ++3.
A Saldaean Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah publicly but of the Black Ajah in truth. Her strength level was 18(6).
A Domani Wise Woman and Kin in Ebou Dar. Her strength level was 54(42).
A Taraboner Accepted in the White Tower. She was slim, with pale hair and brown eyes.
A Seanchan captain with thirty years in the Ever Victorious Army. He had a dog named Nip.
A queen of Andor during the War of the Hundred Years. She reigned from FY 1073 to 1085.
A Two Rivers woman. She was the oldest in her family, and poked Perrin with her cane.
A High Lord of Tear and the father of Medore. Astoril was old but straight-backed.
An Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and the loyalist contingent. Plump with a formidable bosom.
One of the Seanchan military clerks in Captain Faloun’s office in Almizar.
An Asha’man who was given private lessons by Taim. He was handsome and tall, with blue eyes.
A Two Rivers man with Perrin’s forces in Malden when they saved Faile and others.
A fat man from the Two Rivers. He helped to defend Emond’s Field from Trollocs.
A Taraboner Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah in public, but of the Black Ajah in truth.
A Borderland farmwife. She was Renald’s wife.
Andoran High Seat of House Pensenor. He supported Elayne in the Succession.
Tuon’s fourteen-year-old sister; Tuon thought her too young to be plotting against her.
One of Myrelle’s Warders, a Saldaean. He was hawk-nosed and square-chinned.
A woman in Ravinda, Kandor, interviewed by Moiraine during her search.
A man in Marcedin who kept pigeons. He sent reports out for Ronde Macura.
A Maiden who was badly wounded at Malden.
A woman of the Nine Valleys sept of the Taardad Aiel, born in 980 NE.
A gate guard in Baerlon, Andor, who let Moiraine and her party into Baerlon.
An Asha’man who was with Ituralde in Maradon and at Shayol Ghul.
An Arafellin Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and the loyalist contingent, with a strength level of 18(6).
A woman in a song who has a rooster. At least one version of the song was actually about a rooster.
An Illianer trader in Far Madding with a white beard and pointed nose.
A Two Rivers man in Perrin’s army. He sometimes acted as Perrin’s bodyguard.
The Domani High Captain of the Tower Guard and advisor to Marya Sedai.
An Aes Sedai who lived at the time of the formation of the White Tower.
A serving girl at an inn called Culain’s Hound, in Caemlyn.
A Sea Folk Windfinder with a strength level of 18(6).
An ancient name meaning “Heart of the Dark" and used by Ishamael.
A man of the Jhirad sept of the Goshien Aiel and the Sovin Nai society, and the clan chief of the Goshien.
An Aiel Red Shield who fought with Rhuarc in the Last Battle.
A Ghealdanin noblewoman ordered flogged by the Prophet.
An Aiel woman whose daughter was a Wise One’s apprentice.
A Maiden of the Spear of the Black Rock sept of the Shaarad Aiel, born in 981 NE.
A farmer in Andor from whom Alpert Mull bought hay.
A Wise One of the Haido sept of the Shaarad Aiel. She was a dreamwalker but she could not channel.
A Seanchan captain under Banner-General Tylee Khirgan. He had yellow hair and scars on his face.
A soldier in Lan’s army at Tarwin’s Gap. He always had a crossbow tied to the back of his horse.
A Domani sword-swallower and fire-eater with Luca’s show. His brother was Abar.
The Swordbearer to the Throne of the Clouds for Queen Ethenielle of Kandor.
Verin’s first Warder. It took ten years for her to get over his death and bond Tomas.
An Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah who served as Amyrlin from 115 to 142 NE.
An Aes Sedai who was an advisor to Ishara, the first Andoran queen.
An Illianer nobleman who was a member of the Council of Nine.
A Forsaken whose original name was Eval Ramman. He became Aran'gar (Halima) after being reincarnated.
Another name for Balwen Mayel.
The Last king of Aridhol; he was also called Balwen Ironhand.
A Two Rivers man who joined Perrin’s army. He had dark hair and a prominent nose.
A widower in Jarra, Ghealdan. He was dragged through the wedding arches by Widow Jorath.
A young man from Emond’s Field. He joined Perrin’s army at Malden. Called "Ban" for short.
The name taken by Demandred in Shara.
A square-faced Emond’s Field man. Nynaeve caught him with Kimry Lewin in his father’s hayloft.
A young Tairen lord who was foppish and fastidious and always seemed to be looking down his sharp nose.
A woman who was raised Aes Sedai during the Trolloc Wars. Anselan was her Warder.
A lanky, long-legged Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and the loyalist contingent.
An Andoran nobleman and High Seat of his minor House who was loyal to Elayne,
A member of Ituralde’s personal guard in Saldaea.
A juggler with Valan Luca’s show; he worked with his brother Kin.
A palace retainer of more than twenty years’ service in the Royal Palace in Caemlyn.
Demandred’s name before he turned to the Shadow.
An Andoran man from Kore Springs who followed Gareth Bryne when he chased after Siuan, Leane and Min.
The deceased husband of Maglin. He and his wife were the innkeepers of The Nine Rings in Cairhien.
A lean man in Ebou Dar. He mortally wounded Masic in a duel.
An acrobat in Luca’s circus, one of four men said to be brothers, although the four looked very different.
The mayor of Hinderstap. He was sturdy, with dark hair and a beard.
The leader of the Whitecloak scouts with Galad after Galad became Lord Captain Commander.
A Cairhienin member of Cha Faile. Camaille was his sister. He accompanied Perrin to Almizar.
A man near Tremonsien, Cairhien. He was on his way to deliver brandy to The Nine Rings.
The Master of Blades of Atha’an Miere when Nesta din Reas was Mistress of the Ships.
A Borderlander merchant who brought a caravan to Heeth Tower.
A member of the Deathwatch Guard.
A Cairhienin nobleman and a Darkfriend. He became High Seat of his House upon the death of Laman.
The innkeeper at The Wayfarer’s Rest in Whitebridge, Andor. He was fat and balding.
Warder to Erian. He was left in Cairhien when Erian went with Cadsuane to find Rand.
A Shienaran soldier who came to follow and believe in Masema.
Merana’s Warder. He died before the Aiel War, and she never bonded another.
The innkeeper of The Queen’s Blessing in Caemlyn. Called "Basel Gill", "Basel", "Gill", and "Master Gill".
An alias of Graendal.
A Domani soldier with Lan at the end of the Aiel War. He fell asleep on guard duty, and Lan woke him up.
One of Merise’s Warders. He was Cairhienin, 5'8" tall, with dark hair and eyes and a sun-dark face.
Perrin’s Cairhienin quartermaster. He had blond hairs speckled through his graying brown and a pale face.
The captain and owner of the Spray. He is called "Bayle", "Domon", "Captain Domon", and "Master Domon".
An Andoran soldier in Jarid Sarand’s service as one of his personal guardsmen.
A Forsaken known as the Envious and the Netweaver. His name in the AoL was Duram Laddel Cham.
A male Aes Sedai and scientific genius from the Age of Legends. He was involved with the drilling of the Bore.
An Aiel woman held gai’shain by Bair who refused to put off the white at the end of her term of service.
A shaggy brown mare that originally belonged to Tam and Rand al’Thor.
A former queen of Saldaea who married and put her husband away four times.
The head cook at the Sun Palace in Cairhien. She was on duty when Loial and Karldin arrived there.
A Saldaean Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the loyalist contingent, with a strength level of 16(4).
An Arafellin Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 25(13).
A Cairhienin noblewoman, ten years older than Rand. Her clothing’s stripes reached below her breasts.
A Wise One of the Shaido Aiel with the ability to channel and a strength level of 18(6).
A Redarm in the Band of the Red Hand. He was killed when Moghedien balefired the boat.
A scarred Shaido Aiel who was the leader of Far Aldazar Din and the chief of the Green Salts sept.
A soldier in Lan’s army in the Last Battle. He wore a Taraboner veil with a hadori above it.
A Youngling killed by Shaido; he was the first to die at Dumai’s Wells.
A Two Rivers man who starved himself to death because he thought someone was trying to poison him.
A Shienaran Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and the loyalist contingent, with a strength level of 37(25).
A Taraboner Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and apparently of the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 16(4).
An Andoran Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 14(2).
A lanky, bearded Lord Captain of the Children of the Light.
A Maiden of the Spear who stood guard for Rand in Caemlyn.
A Shienaran Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and the rebel contingent, with a strength level of 28(16).

A mercenary who joined Perrin’s army along with Turne. Jarr had had a horse, but they ate him.
The husband of Setalle. He was square-faced and gray-haired.
Asmodean’s identity as a gleeman. He appeared dark-haired and in his middle years.
A novice in the Tower. She was among the strongest that Egwene recruited to help fight against the Seanchan.
An Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and the loyalist contingent. About 5'6" tall, she had a bony frame, with an angular face.
Old Tongue for “True Finder.” Rand’s dappled stallion bore this name.
A Domani Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah, but Black Ajah in truth. She had black hair and dark brown eyes
The greatest blademaster in history. Jearom fought over ten thousand times, in battle and single combat.
An Aiel who was Far Dareis Mai. She accompanied Perrin to Ghealdan. She had gray eyes and dark brown hair.
A servant in the Tarasin Palace. He was a short, bullish young man.
A name used by the Darkfriend Torwyn Barshaw. He was alleged to be Paitr Conel’s uncle and a merchant.
An Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and the loyalist contingent. About 5'4" tall, she was sturdy and had a pale, square face.
A Maiden of the Cold Peak Miagoma who died guarding Rand’s door at the Sun Palace in Cairhien.
A big-eyed, pretty Murandian noblewoman who became a novice with the rebels.
An Andoran Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the rebel contingent. Her parents were innkeepers in Caemlyn.
An Aielman with whom Mat played a knife-throwing game in Rhuidean. He was built like a bear.
The governor of the province of Andor for Artur Hawkwing. He translated the Prophecies of the Dragon.
An Aielman who was the son of Lewin, one of the first Aiel to use a weapon.
An Illianer nobleman who was a member of the Council of the Nine. He was beardless with a narrow jaw.
A stout Illianer merchant buying gems in Saldaea. He was dark-eyed with gray in his pointed beard.
A boy in the Two Rivers whom Mat, as a teen, had saved from drowning.
A serving girl at The White Ring in Maderin, Altara. She served Mat, Tuon and Selucia; Mat tipped her a silver penny.
The name used by Padan Fain when he was in Cairhien advising Toram Riatin.
The innkeeper of The Good Queen in Aringill, Andor. Thom and Mat stayed in the stable at his inn.
A young soldier in the Children of the Light who was sent with a message from Carridin to Geofram Bornhald.
A Cairhienin farrier in Perrin’s camp in Ghealdan. He was just short of his middle years.
A Kandori infant who was on Moiraine’s list of potential Dragons Reborn. He and his father were killed in a barn fire.
A skinny Two Rivers girl with the ability to channel. She was among the young women recruited by Verin and Alanna.
The mayor of Watch Hill, Andor. He was wide-nosed, leathery-faced and white-haired. He goes by "Jer".
A young Whitecloak soldier.
A Wise One of the Shaido Aiel with the ability to channel. Very short for an Aiel, no more than 5'2" tall.
A member of the Kin. She was golden-haired and young-looking.
An Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and a loyalist. About 5'1" tall and wiry, she resembled a sparrow.
A historical Aes Sedai that Faile used as an example of Aes Sedai doing whatever the White Tower ordered.
Birgitte’s name in another life, in which she took Gaidal Cain to the Tower of Ghenjei to save him from a head wound.
A Tairen Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and the loyalist contingent. She was dark with a square face.
The innkeeper of The Light of Truth in Sienda, Amadicia. She was plump, with gray hair in long curls.
A man of the Haido sept of the Shaarad Aiel and of the Sovin Nai society who was clan chief of the Shaarad.
A Mera’din who joined the Shaido and was Rolan’s friend. Squat for an Aielman, with blue eyes and red-gold hair.
A Saldaean soldier under Bashere in Caemlyn. He had odd ideas about Aes Sedai.
A captured damane from Seanchan who was sent to Elayne. She felt that women who could channel must be collared.
A girl from Emond’s Field. When Egwene first carried water for the annual shearing, Jillie was seventeen.
A plump Ebou Dari goldsmith who was at the Kin’s farm outside Ebou Dar. She fled along with Elayne and Nynaeve.
High Captain of the White Tower Guard. He was a good soldier and a good enough general, but overly impetuous.
A Seanchan damane who belonged to the Lady Morsa. She had short yellow hair and looked almost motherly.
One of two damane present at Morgase’s meeting with Suroth. The other present was Pura.
A Youngling with Gawyn. He had a boy’s grin, but wore the silver tower on his collar that marked him a veteran.
The last king of Aldeshar, a nation from after the Trolloc Wars, and the father of Endara Casalain.
A name Birgitte went by in a past life.
One of the group of Shienaran soldiers who joined Lan in eastern Kandor as he traveled toward Tarwin’s Gap.
Asmodean’s name in the Age of Legends.
A Child of the Light. Dain Bornhald sent him and Gomanes with Ordeith to find out what he was up to.
A king of Ghealdan. He stripped Logain of his land and titles when Logain declared himself the Dragon Reborn.
A woman of the Black Rock sept of the Shaarad Aiel and Far Dareis Mai.
A child that Egwene had with Rand, during her Accepted test.
An Andoran Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and Black Ajah in truth. She was a handsome woman with a friendly face.
One of Kin Tovere’s apprentice lensmakers in Cairhien. He helped set up the large looking glasses.
A woman of the Salt Flat sept of the Nakai Aiel and Far Dareis Mai. She had red-gold hair and blue eyes.
An Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. About 5'4" tall, with dark brown hair and large brown eyes, she was quite pretty.
A man from the Age of Legends. He was wide-shouldered with a narrow beard and dark hair.
A blacksmith in Jarra, Ghealdan. Rilith, who was young enough to be his daughter, suddenly asked him to marry her.
A Two Rivers farmer. He was bald and hulking. Jon and Thad Torfinn went to Faile to settle a boundary dispute.
A Two Rivers farmer. His farm lay on the North Road. Jon joined Perrin’s army at Malden.
A barber in the Royal Palace in Caemlyn who served in the palace under Morgase. He was later identified as a spy.
The miller of Emond’s Field and a member of the Village Council. His son Lem also saw the Fade that Rand did.
A Da’shain Aiel man who lived at the time of the Breaking. The son of Coumin, he married Alnora, a Dreamer.
An Asha’man from Altara. He could channel just enough to make a gateway of usable size.
A queen of Saldaea whose son had a gambling problem. Faile used her as an example that no leader was perfect.
An old Two Rivers man who was respected by the Aiel as a skilled woodsman. A grizzled fellow who liked to spit.
An Andoran man who was once a Senior Bannerman of the Queen’s Guards. He was big and balding with white hair.
A young man from Emond’s Field. He was the grandson of Buel Dowtry. Taim recruited him to the Black Tower.
Lan’s bald Malkieri standard-bearer in the Last Battle.
A woman in Jarra, Ghealdan, who dragged old Banas through the wedding arches after Rand passed through the town.
A purported chandler who was actually a talented torturer; he worked for Milisair Chadmar.
Morvrin’s Warder. He was about 5'4" tall, almost as wide as he was tall, bald and square-faced.
A Two Rivers man. He was skinny although he ate twice as much as anyone else.
The Royal Historian to the Court of Ethenielle of Kandor; she wrote the introduction to “The Strike at Shayol Ghul.”
A Darkfriend merchant in Amador, and the husband of Amellia. His mind was profoundly damaged by Temaile.
The Sea Folk Windfinder of the Wavedancer and sister to its Sailmistress, Coine. Jorin could channel.
An Aes Sedai from before the Breaking who made wondrous ter’angreal; he died when the Sharom was destroyed.
A man who taught Malidra to use a nail to scrape meat from a bone in Aviendha’s viewing of the future in Rhuidean.
An Aiel clan chief. He was small with some Andoran blood. Seen in Aviendha’s viewing of the future in Rhuidean.
An Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the loyalist contingent. A search of her rooms revealed an angreal.
A Kandori man who was always lucky. His son was on Moiraine’s list of potential Dragons Reborn.
Perrin’s mother. She was killed by Padan Fain along with the rest of her family.
Egwene’s alias while aboard the Darter on the way from Jurene to Tear.
The head mason building a new wing on the White Tower library. Danelle was supposed to be watching him.
A victim of the gholam. He was found in Farrier’s Green with his throat ripped out and his body drained of blood.
An ancient Ogier woman who was the grandmother of Moilin.
A Ghealdanin Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. About 5'7" tall, dark-eyed and very attractive with almost black hair.
A Tairen thief-catcher. He was about 5'10" tall, and lean, with skin as dark as old roots. Sometimes called "Sandar".

Alphabetical Name: Juin son of Lacel son of Laud
Full Name: Juin son of Lacel son of Laud
Description: An Ogier in Stedding Tsofu.
A member of the Kin. Plump and pretty, with some white in her dark hair, Julanya spent twenty years as a peddler.
An Andoran Asha’man. He was stocky and dark-eyed with a weathered farmer’s face. Married to Sora.
A soldier under Lord Luan Norwelyn in Andor.
An officer at the Aesdaishar Palace in Chachin, Kandor. He had ridden with Lan in the south during the Aiel War.
The innkeeper of The Star in Tear. He was stout with a round face and balding. Also called "Jurah" and "Master Haret".
An Aielman who was leader of Aethan Dor. He was slender with streaks of white in his pale brown hair.
An Aielman serving as gai’shain to Amys. After his time as gai’shain was up, he refused to put off the white.
A Kandori woman whose son was on Moiraine’s list of potential Dragons Reborn.
The Right Hand to the Queen of Almoren, and the author of Commentaries on the Prophecies of the Dragon.
One of the kings in the gleeman tale “Mara and the Three Foolish Kings.”
A member of the Queen’s Guard who brought word to Birgitte that an intruder had been picked up entering the city.
A Maiden with dark hair, unusual for an Aiel.
An Andoran Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and the rebel contingent. About 5'4" tall, she had blue eyes and an oval face.
A Seanchan sul’dam of the low Blood. Tall, with long black hair worn in a braid.
Ethenielle’s grandson, a prince of Kandor. He joined Lan and served with him at Tarwin’s Gap.
A Shienaran nobleman encountered by Rand in Fal Dara. He was about 6'4" to 6'5" tall, and lean and lanky.
Furyk Karede’s wife. They had three sons together; two followed Karede into the Deathwatch Guards.
One of Saldaean Queen Tenobia’s many uncles. He was scarred and grizzled, with the face of a leathery eagle.
Graendal’s name in the Age of Legends.
A banker in Chachin, Kandor, whom Moiraine visited to cash in a letter-of-rights. In her middle years, she was lovely.
A Maiden of the Spear who guarded Rand in the city of Tear.
A member of Ituralde’s forces in Saldaea. Ituralde sent him to Alin with a message.
A Wise Woman in a fishing village near Toman Head. She was taken by the Seanchan and made damane.
A Domani Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah publicly and of the Black Ajah in truth. Of the loyalist contingent.
A young lord of a minor Andoran House, loyal to Sarand. He and Jarid Sarand were friends from childhood.
A young Kandori noblewoman who sent soldiers to the Aiel War. She was a patron to Josef Najima and his wife.
An Aes Sedai who lived at the time of the formation of the White Tower.
The daughter of an Andoran merchant from Caemlyn who ran a trading house in Illian. She married Tam al’Thor.
An Emond’s Field girl. Egwene thought she might be able to channel.
A woman in the story “How Goodwife Karil Cured Her Husband of Snoring.”
One of Kerene’s Warders. He was massive, with golden hair and a golden beard that gave him the aspect of a lion.
An Andoran noblewoman, High Seat of House Anshar. Stolid and about 5'4" tall, she had gray streaks in her dark hair.
An Andoran Asha’man. He was one of the early Asha’man, a pale-haired youth with blue-gray eyes.
Tylee Khirgan’s longtime quartermaster. He was a solid man who made very few mistakes.
An Asha’man in Taim’s faction. He joined shortly before the Last Battle, quickly became very strong and was promoted.
A Saldaean under-lieutenant of the Children of the Light. He appeared almost boyish despite thick mustaches.
A woman who was a kitchen helper in the Sun Palace in Cairhien. She was present when Loial and Karldin arrived.
An Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. A prodigious reader, she refused to heed the Amyrlin’s advice to stay alert.
A golden-haired Maiden of the Spear who guarded Rand’s tent the night before the meeting at the Field of Merrilor.
An Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, but actually Black Ajah. About 5'6" tall, she was sharp-faced, with wavy black hair.
The innkeeper of The Yearly Brawl in Ebou Dar. She was married to Jame, a Seanchan.
A serving girl at The Dusty Wheel in Caemlyn. Beautiful, with raven hair and a wide smile, she flirted with Mat.
The first queen of Murandy.
The Lord of Fal Eisen, Shienar. A sharp-faced man with a harsh voice.
A maid with the Salidar Aes Sedai. Chesa thought that she and Nildra were terrible gossips.
A Saldaean stableman at the Gates of Heaven in Canluum. Skinny with a hooked nose and tilted eyes.
An Altaran novice with the rebels in Salidar, where she was recruited. She did not like being ordered about by Elayne.
The son of Malenarin Rai, the commander of Heeth Tower on the Blightborder. He was a few days short of 14.
The innkeeper at The Counsel’s Head in Far Madding. She wore her white hair in a tight bun and had a pointed chin.
A young gate guard in Maderin, Altara, who was about Mat’s age.
A bold man in a song sung at The White Ring in Maderin.
A persona Lanfear used when she traveled with Hadnan Kadere. In this guise she was immensely fat, with dark eyes.
An Andoran man who was High Seat of his House. A vinegary old man, he was loyal to Elayne.
An Andoran weaver who was one of the first to be tested for Asha’man at the farm. Lumpy and dark-haired.
A Kinswoman who was part of Elayne’s contingent at her Cairhienin coronation. She was dark-skinned with black hair.
A prince of Arafel who was the grandson of King Paitar. He and his armies joined Lan as he rode for Tarwin’s Gap.
A young Two Rivers man who joined Perrin’s band and was killed in an ambush by Trollocs.
A young Two Rivers man who followed Perrin to Dumai’s Wells. Short and stocky, he was barely old enough to marry.
A Seanchan Captain-General of the Ever Victorious Army, and of the Blood.
Eldrith’s Warder. He was not a Darkfriend, and intended to kill her when he found her despite the cost to himself.
A Tairen of noble birth, an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the loyalist contingent. She had the blue eyes and fair hair.
A Kinswoman who appeared to be Saldaean. Short and slim, with tilted green eyes and fiery red curls.
A Domani youth who worked as a chandler’s apprentice. Under Graendal’s Compulsion, he killed a messenger.
An Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. She had short dark hair with a little white and her eyes were nearly black.
A man from the Two Rivers who fought in the Last Battle.
A Two Rivers man who went with Tam and joined Perrin’s army at Malden.
A Two Rivers man with Perrin. He told Perrin of the stand of trees that had mysteriously died and dried in one night.
An elderly Two Rivers man. He participated in the defense of Emond’s Field.
An Aes Sedai who lived at the time of the formation of the White Tower.
A girl in the Two Rivers whom Mat in his youth had tried to save from drowning, although she wasn't really drowning.
A young woman from Emond’s Field. Nynaeve caught her with Bar Dowtry in his father’s hayloft.
The man who taught Tam to summon the flame and the void.
A juggler with Valan Luca’s show. He performed with his brother Bari.
A Cairhienin lensmaker who made looking glasses for Rand to use in the battle for Cairhien.
A captain in Elayne’s Queen’s Guard in Aringill.
An Aiel Mera’din who joined the Jumai Shaido. He had green eyes and full lips.
See Lews Therin Telamon
A young commander of Ghealdanin lancers under Arganda. He was so tall that he had to bend to listen to Arganda.
An Illianer nobleman who was a member of the Council of Nine. He was a stork of a man with a square-cut beard.
A Jenn Aiel girl from a time right after the Breaking who was kidnapped. She was Morin’s daughter.
An Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah who served as Amyrlin from 922 to 950 NE. Kirin was a weak Amyrlin.
One of Bashere’s Saldaean soldiers who died in the Trolloc raid on Lord Algarin’s manor in Tear.
A Kin Elder with the Knitting Circle in Ebou Dar. About 5'5" tall, she had black eyes and pale skin.
A soldier queen who was the Queen of Aramaelle. See also Sword of Kirukan
An Arafellin Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and the rebel contingent. Elegant and statuesque, she was 5'7" tall.
A maid in Berelain’s palace in Mayene who fetched Berelain to see Annoura and Galad.
An Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who served as Amyrlin from 171 to 197 NE. Kiyosa was a strong Amyrlin.
An Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the loyalist contingent. She was tall and slender.
A Warder who lost his Aes Sedai in the Last Battle and joined Galad to fight on and avenge her.
Old Tongue for “devastation” or “ruin”; it was the name given to Mat by Tuon.
A young male Aes Sedai from the time of the Breaking who helped create the Eye of the World.
An Ogier who was the father of Shandin father of Ledar.
Son of Radlin, father of Serden, the last being an Ogier author who theorized about the Ways.
An Altaran merchant who played a version of Piri with Mat at The White Ring in Maderin, Altara.
A soldier in Lan’s army who died fighting a Myrddraal; he did something crazy in that fight, according to Andere.
A soldier at Heeth Tower whom Malenarin Rai sent to fetch the sword for the ceremony raising his son to manhood.
A Seanchan woman who brought in three assassins to kill Tuon.
An acrobat with Valan Luca’s show. Dark-haired and dark-skinned, she was one of six purported sisters.
One of the group of Shienaran soldiers who joined Lan in eastern Kandor as he traveled toward Tarwin’s Gap.
A stout graying Kinswoman who traveled with Elayne to Caemlyn.
A Shienaran Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She was 5'5" tall, and handsome rather than pretty, with sharp blue eyes.
A Sea Folk Windfinder. Her face was like smooth black stone, her full lips seemed thin and her eyes were black.
An Arafellin Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the rebel contingent. Standing 5'3½" tall, she was dark and slender.
A poet of Shiota, and a translator of The Prophecies of the Dragon between FY 700 and 800.
A Wise One of the Tomanelle Aiel. Han was her sister-father. She had deep red hair and a long, tanned face.
A nobleman and counselor to King Paitar of Arafel. He was 6'3" tall, lean and elegant-looking.
A member of the Band of the Red Hand who accompanied Faile on supply runs in the Last Battle.
An Ogier who was the son of Laud and the father of Juin.
A Cairhienin member of Cha Faile. About 5'3" tall, and slim, with a pale complexion, dark eyes and short dark hair,.
A Sea Folk Wavemistress who was one of the First Twelve. She was so slender that her bosom seemed enormous.
A Wise One of the Taardad Aiel after the Last Battle, seen in Aviendha’s viewing of the future in Rhuidean.
King of Coremanda who signed the Compact of the Ten Nations.
A soldier in Mat’s Band of the Red Hand. Short, stocky and seemingly mild.
Another name for Semirhage.
An Ogier man from Stedding Shangtai. Loial encountered him in Tear.
A man of the Moshaine sept of the Shaido Aiel and of the Duadhe Mahdi’in society.
An Andoran nobleman and High Seat of his House. Stocky and taciturn and normally as stolid as stone.
A Taraboner Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and the loyalist contingent. She was part of the group that kidnapped Rand.
A young woman of the Two Rivers. Married to Natley Lewin. At one time, Perrin wanted to marry her, and she him.
Presumably the name of Laila Dearn after she was married to Natley Lewin (or possibly "Laila Dearn Lewin").
A man in Bandar Eban for whom Votabek and Redborn were working.
A Malkieri man who was the brother of al’Akir and Lan’s uncle. He and al’Akir were very close.
An Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah who was toadlike in appearance.
A member of the Children of the Light who believed that a dead channeler’s head should be cut off.
A daughter of Artur Hawkwing. She and her son died a tragic death.
A king of Cairhien who took the throne in 965 NE. Laman was the uncle of Moiraine Damodred.
A woman of the Smoke Water sept of the Miagoma Aiel and Far Dareis Mai. She was lean with dark red hair.
A bouncer at The Queen’s Blessing, Caemlyn. He was a hulking fellow with scars on his face and hands.
A man who was by right the King of Malkier, Lord of the Seven Towers, Lord of the Lakes, True Blade of Malkier.
A lieutenant at Heeth Tower. He was roused to take command of the top of the tower.
One of the Forsaken, born Mierin Eronaile. About 5'11" tall, with dark eyes and black hair. Slender and very beautiful.
A novice (or Accepted). After Siuan was deposed, she was taken by the rebels to Salidar.
An ancient scholar from the Blue Ajah who wrote of the Forsaken.
A Two Rivers girl. Egwene thought that she might be able to channel.
The chief cook in the White Tower. Siuan gave her the formal title of Mistress of the Kitchens.
A Domani Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was beautiful, with copper skin.
A senior maid at the Tarasin Palace in Ebou Dar.
The damane name of Lemore, a noblewoman from Tanchico. See Lemore Genhal.
A Two Rivers girl with channeling ability. She was recruited by Verin and Alanna. She was Dav’s sister and about 18.
An Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah, but actually Black Ajah. A bony woman whose was plain.
A woman whom Thom once tried to rescue. She was a rose in bud, and married to a brutish bootmaker.
A woman who trained bears in Valan Luca’s circus. She was stern-faced and dark-eyed, with short black hair.
A Whitecloak soldier who was killed by Hopper in the stedding that featured Hawkwing’s statue.
A young Cairhienin nobleman who was a member of Cha Faile. Short and pale, he had a pointed nose.
An Aes Sedai at the time of the War of Power. She opposed Lews Therin’s plan of sealing the Bore.
An Ogier who was the father of Lacel and the grandfather of Juin.
A noblewoman attending Morgase in Amadicia. Slender with dark eyes and a permanent simper.
A Redarm in the Band of the Red Hand who accompanied Mat to Ebou Dar.
A Redarm in the Band of the Red Hand. He accompanied Mat to Ebou Dar.
The Aiel name for the Dark One.
A wolf who was the leader of her pack. She had a feel of quiet certainty; her mate was Feather.
A Domani Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah originally, but later of the Green. She was willowy, graceful and coppery-skinned.
Lan’s mother, the last Queen of Malkier. Always referred to as el’Leanna in the books.
The Ogier author of A Study of Men, Women and the One Power Among Humans.

Primary Name: Loial son of Arent son of Halan
Description: Loial used the name Ledar to disguise his identity.
A citizen of Hinderstap who spoke with Mayor Barlden about the papers with Mat’s likeness.
A Maiden of the Spear sent after Weiramon and Anaiyella when Rand outed them as Darkfriends.
An Asha’man who was Taim’s crony and was fond of wine.
A member of Ituralde’s forces who died defending his flank from Trollocs outside Maradon.
The local healer in Remen, Altara. She stitched up Lords Orban and Gann after their encounter with Gaul and Sarien.
Name taken by Egeanin Sarna.
A Taraboner noblewoman who was shipped out to the Seanchan forces after she was mistakenly kidnapped.
A man of the Cosaida sept of the Chareen Aiel and the Sha’mad Conde society.
The wife of the Asha’man Canler. Round and white-haired, she was bonded by Canler.
A Tairen Lady of the Land. She made the mistake of looking disdainfully at Moiraine.
A Kandori Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and the rebel contingent. About 5'4" tall, she was slender and quite pretty.
A horse-faced Two Rivers man in Perrin’s army. He had a gap in his teeth through which he sometimes spat.
A boy from Emond’s Field who was the son of Jon and Saera Thane. He was eight months younger than Rand.
An Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and the loyalist contingent. She was part of the expedition to take the Black Tower.
A Taraboner noblewoman taken by the Seanchan in Tanchico and made damane (and renamed "Larie").
A Two Rivers man who, along with Jac Coplin, stole a cow from Master Thane.
A mythical character in gleeman tales who flew to the moon in the belly of an eagle made of fire.
A Two Rivers man with deep-set eyes and a white streak in his hair where a scar ran through it.
Meidani’s Arafellin Warder. He wore silver bells in his hair and two swords on his back.
A serving girl at The Wandering Woman in Ebou Dar.
A Goshien Aiel woman of Far Dareis Mai. Lean, sandy-haired and about Faile’s age.
The head mason working on Elaida’s palace at the White Tower.
A Murandian novice with the rebel Aes Sedai. Pale-eyed and close to her middle years with unblemished skin.
An old Tairen fisherman who became wealthy after finding three cuendillar bowls and a cup in his nets.
A young Jenn Aiel man from the time soon after the Breaking. Adan was his greatfather.
An Emond’s Field woman. Nynaeve caught her daughter Kimry in the hayloft with Bar Dowtry.
A leader in the Age of Legends. A very accomplished man, he held many offices and was a well known author.
A Tuatha’an woman. Gray-haired but with few lines on her face, she rode into the Mountains of Mist to find Moiraine.
An Aiel Wise One who could channel quite strongly.
A woman of the Cosaida sept of the Chareen Aiel and Far Dareis Mai. Her hair was nearly black, which was rare.
A Taraboner rug weaver. One of the refugees who went to the Two Rivers.
One of the Heroes of the Horn featured in “Lian’s Stand,” recited by Thom, and part of The Great Hunt of the Horn.
A woman of the Nine Valleys sept of the Taardad Aiel. She was Rhuarc's, and the roofmistress of Cold Rocks Hold.
A Taraboner Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, but actually Black Ajah. She was honey blonde with a rosebud mouth.
A serving girl at The Nine Rings in Tremonsien, Cairhien. She was sent to fetch Selene’s bags.
An Aes Sedai who lived at the time of the formation of the White Tower.
A young officer from Arad Doman, the son of Lord Shimron, who served under Rodel Ituralde.
A damane belonging to Tuon. Red-haired with freckled cheeks, she spoke a Foretelling for Tuon.
A Darkfriend merchant who ran supplies for the Shadow through the Blasted Lands to a spot near the Town.
Other name for the Creator.
Other name for the Creator.
A title for the Dark One.
Moghedien’s name in the Age of Legends.
Nickname that Therava uses for Galina.
A Sea Folk Wavemistress who was one of the First Twelve.
The innkeeper of The Great Gathering, at the Black Tower. She was short and dark-haired.
An Ogier woman who was the eldest of the Ogier in Stedding Sholoon.
The childhood nurse of Elayne, Morgase and Morgase’s mother. Mouthy and independent.
The name of the horse belonging to Lord Orban, the Hunter of the Horn who captured Gaul.
The horse Elayne rode in Ebou Dar; she was killed when Elayne’s unraveling gateway exploded.
An Andoran man who was High Seat of House Baryn. Blade-slender and blade-strong, he opposed Morgase.
A serving girl at the Blue Rose in Canluum, Kandor who had eyes for Lan. She had full lips and dark eyes.

One of Jarid Sarand’s soldiers, most likely a scout.

Egwene’s horse, a testy dapple gelding.
An Aiel name for the Dark One.
